nodes.summary: For a subgroup $A$ of a group $G$ and an element $x \in G$, the conjugate subgroup is $A^x = x^{-1} A x = \{x^{-1} a x : a \in A\}$.
nodes.title: Conjugate subgroup

nodes.summary: A subgroup $A$ of a group $G$ is paranormal (Z. I. Borevich) when, for every $x \in G$, the conjugate $A^x = x^{-1} A x$ is contained in the subgroup generated by the conjugates $A^u$ with $u$ in the subgroup $\langle A, A^x \rangle$ generated by $A$ and $A^x$.
nodes.title: Paranormal subgroup

nodes.summary: A subgroup $A$ of a group $G$ is polynormal (Z. I. Borevich) when, for every $x \in G$, the conjugate $A^x = x^{-1} A x$ is contained in the subgroup generated by the conjugates $A^u$ with $u \in A^{\langle x \rangle}$, where $A^{\langle x \rangle}$ is the subgroup generated by the conjugates $A^{x^n}$ with $n \in \mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Polynormal subgroup

nodes.summary: There is a finite group $G$ with a subgroup $A$ that is polynormal but not paranormal. So the conjecture of Kourovka Problem 14.50 is false.
nodes.title: A polynormal subgroup that is not paranormal (Kourovka 14.50 refuted)

nodes.summary: Kourovka 14.50 (Z. I. Borevich; A. S. Kondratiev): every polynormal subgroup of a finite group is paranormal.
nodes.title: Polynormal subgroups of finite groups are paranormal

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
